text: make a flyer for a printmakers open studio
withheld: The address is "Unit 14B, Second Floor, The Old Foundry Arts Centre, 127–129 St. John's Road, Kingston upon Thames, KT1 2AB".
Keep the whole address exactly as written, including every word, letter, number and punctuation mark in order; do not shorten or abbreviate it.
The address can wrap over multiple lines.
Use no extra words on the flyer.
Make one portrait digital flyer with a width-to-height ratio of 4:5; no particular platform.
Fonts and layout are your choice.
